faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Last order is taken at 9:30 PM.

faqs.question: How do I make a reservation?
faqs.answer: You can make a reservation through our Reservations page. Simply select your preferred date, time, and party size. You'll receive a confirmation email once your table is booked.

faqs.question: Do you offer delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer delivery services within 5km of our restaurant. Delivery charges may apply based on distance. Estimated delivery time is 30-45 minutes.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), eSewa, and Khalti for online payments. For dine-in, we also accept credit/debit cards.

faqs.question: Do you have vegetarian options?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a wide variety of vegetarian dishes clearly marked with a 'Veg' badge on our menu. Our kitchen also takes extra care to avoid cross-contamination.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled within 5 minutes of placing them. Please contact our support team immediately if you need to cancel. Once the order is being prepared, cancellation may not be possible.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: You can track your order status in real-time from your Orders page. You'll receive notifications when your order is confirmed, being prepared, ready, and delivered/served.

faqs.question: Do you offer special discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer special discounts for birthdays, anniversaries, and loyalty program members. Follow us on social media for seasonal promotions and offers.

faqs.question: Is there a loyalty program?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a loyalty points program. You earn 10 points for every NPR 100 spent. Points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders.

faqs.question: Do you have parking facilities?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have free parking available for our dine-in customers. Our parking area can accommodate up to 20 vehicles.

faqs.question: Do you cater to dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accommodate various dietary restrictions including gluten-free, vegan, and nut allergies. Please mention your requirements in the special instructions when ordering.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach our customer support team at +977 9801234567 or email support@dineease.com. We're available 24/7 to assist you.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Reservations can be cancelled up to 1 hour before the booking time. Food orders can be cancelled within 5 minutes of placing. No-shows may be charged a fee.

faqs.question: Do you serve alcohol?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a full bar serving beer, wine, and cocktails. We also have non-alcoholic beverages and mocktails.

faqs.question: Is there a kids menu?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a special kids menu with child-friendly portions and prices. Kids under 10 eat free on Sundays!

faqs.question: Do you accept group bookings?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept group bookings for parties of 10 or more. Please contact us at least 3 days in advance for special arrangements.

faqs.question: What is your average price per person?
faqs.answer: The average price per person is around NPR 800-1200 depending on your order. We have options for every budget!

faqs.question: Do you have WiFi?
faqs.answer: Yes, free WiFi is available for all dine-in customers. Network: DineEase, Password: dine@123

faqs.question: Do you offer takeaway?
faqs.answer: Yes, takeaway is available. Simply place your order online and select 'Takeaway' option. Your order will be ready in 20-30 minutes.

faqs.question: What are your busiest hours?
faqs.answer: Our busiest hours are 7:00 PM - 9:00 PM on weekends. For faster service, we recommend visiting between 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM or 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you have private dining rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have 2 private dining rooms that can accommodate up to 15 people each. Perfect for business meetings or family gatherings.

faqs.question: Can I bring my own cake?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can bring your own cake for celebrations. We charge a small corkage fee of NPR 200.

faqs.question: Do you have gift cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer digital gift cards in denominations of NPR 500, 1000, 2000, and 5000. They make perfect gifts!

faqs.question: Is your restaurant wheelchair accessible?
faqs.answer: Yes, our restaurant is fully wheelchair accessible with ramps and accessible restrooms.

faqs.question: Do you have a dress code?
faqs.answer: We have a smart casual dress code. No beachwear or sportswear, please.

faqs.question: What happens if I'm late for my reservation?
faqs.answer: We hold reservations for 15 minutes. Please call us if you're running late, and we'll do our best to accommodate you.

faqs.question: Do you offer catering services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer catering for events and parties. Please contact our events team for a customized quote.

faqs.question: Can I order online?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can order directly through our website or mobile app. We accept online payments via eSewa and Khalti.

faqs.question: Do you have happy hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have happy hours from 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM on weekdays with 20% off on select beverages.

faqs.question: What safety measures do you have?
faqs.answer: We follow strict hygiene protocols, regular sanitization, and staff health checks. Your safety is our priority.
